reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-FP: The sink is response.sendRedirect() constructing a URL redirect, not a filesystem path operation. While host is validated via regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.safe\.com$, the rule incorrectly flags this as path-injection. Path injection requires user data to reach filesystem operations (read/write/traverse), not URL redirects. Resolved sink value: "https://" + user_param + "/" + seg constructs a redirect URL, not a filesystem path. This is an open redirect concern, not path injection.

evidence.note: User-controlled param flows to host variable, then used in response.sendRedirect() URL construction - this is redirect, not filesystem path injection
